episode_title: [TEST FIXTURE] Elena Verna on B2B Product-Led Growth & Sales
text:
Welcome to this test fixture episode. Today we discuss Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Product-Led Sales (PLS).

Elena Verna explains that PLG is fundamentally about distribution and customer acquisition efficiency. In traditional top-down sales, marketing generates leads, sales qualifies and closes them, and customer success retains them. In product-led growth, the product itself becomes the primary driver of acquisition, activation, and retention.

However, Elena emphasizes that PLG does not mean no sales. Instead, PLG creates the pipeline for Product-Led Sales. When you have thousands of self-serve users inside organizations, product-qualified leads (PQLs) naturally emerge. Sales teams can then reach out to accounts that already have high product engagement, reducing customer acquisition costs and shortening the sales cycle.

Key metrics for PLG include product signups, activation rate, natural expansion velocity, and time to value. If users do not experience value within their first session, churn increases exponentially. Startups should focus ruthlessly on onboarding simplicity before scaling paid distribution.
